identityConfidence: MEDIUM-HIGH. A state-level pourakarmika convention was held in Bengaluru on 7 April 2025, addressed by Deputy Chief Minister D. K. Shivakumar, who announced a ₹730 crore BBMP welfare allocation (₹500 cr salaries, ₹107 cr pensions, ₹5 cr protective gear). Delegates came from city corporations, town municipalities and other local bodies. This is the strongest match for 'Pourakarmika Samavesha'.
